name: SymfonyOnline January 2027
description: Online Symfony conference, 2 tracks, talks from SymfonyCon Warsaw
note: online, English; 119 EUR until 10 Nov, then 149 EUR
details: Workshops on 12-13 January 2027 (9:00-17:00 CET, no replay), conference on 14-15 January with two tracks per day. Talks are pre-recorded at SymfonyCon Warsaw 2026 with live Q&A by the speakers; replays available as soon as each talk starts. Conference-only ticket 119 EUR until 10 November 2026, then 149 EUR; workshops 379 EUR. Conference hours are not listed.
